content.text: This
is the key architectural insight I needed. The existing pattern
in the codebase is `class="badge badge-runner badge-runner-vscode"` — a multi-class composition
pattern where `.badge` provides the shared layout/typography and variant
classes (`.badge-runner-*`) only provide color.
The new `.badge-scope-global` and `.badge-scope-project` classes follow the same color-
only approach, but the WP spec says they "extend the
existing `.badge` pattern." This means in markup they'll
be used as `class="badge badge-scope-global"` — which is correct
, since `.badge` provides the shared structural styles. The CSS-only WP is

consistent with this pattern. No issue here.
